posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
I guess it's a matter of, I like stuff like novelty, creepy/odd things, things you don't expect, entertaining thematic dissonance.

It's novelty to imagine AZ having a Texan accent since it's not what you'd at all expect. I used "Joisey" because I was being tongue-in-cheek. (Much how I'd be willing to jokingly call myself a Masshole if it was ever applicable to a topic.) I find it kind of amusing from a literary joke perspective that Captain Cosmic is a heroic lawyer.

Also stuff like how I find it interesting that Steel's bio means Megalopolis exists as a giant Sentinelsverse City of Adventure alongside NYC instead of replacing it, especially since the fact that Mrs. Parsons is a Senator for Connecticut and she lives in Megalopolis and IIRC you have to reside in the state you're a Senator for means Megalopolis might possibly be in Connecticut, which would mean there's apparently a whole lot of urbannness going on in the Northeast. (Whew.)

So running into a wall of "You're wrong and your jokes are annoying" felt kind of like, all right then, I guess I can take a hint. (Sort of that equilibrum where you're socially aware enough to realize you're annoying people but not socially aware enough to know what will and won't annoy people ahead of time.)
